independence: The reviewer did not author or render the reel.
scope: Full-resolution reel poster and sixteen timestamped composition samples.
Full-resolution final composition frames at approximately 1.47 seconds and 5.13 seconds, targeting previously problematic hand/hair and rabbit-ear framing.
The selected Riko and Nami identity comparisons and eight synchronized driving/result pairs, reviewed independently before composition.
Read-back of composition lineage, source studio-border reports and all-native-frame foreground-union authoring evidence.
observations: Riko and Nami remain recognizable through their distinct hair, accessories, clothing and footwear; the shaded illustration style remains coherent.
The sampled sequence retains varied poses, including arm crossing, lateral reach, overhead extension, bent knees and head-side gestures.
Both hands, overhead reaches, shoes and Nami rabbit ears fit within the selected stage at the reviewed times. Additional full-size checks of the prior vulnerable intervals show clear lateral margins.
The hierarchy is clear: Meet the cast, character name, supporting line and segment label remain readable with consistent alignment and surrounding space.
The two characters appear in order in separate segments. The composition adds no unreviewed character or intended speech.
The explicit fixed crops contain every recorded foreground bounding box from the 96 native frames per character. This supports the authoring choice without replacing visual review.

framing_authoring_aid.method: Corner-median background with maximum RGB-channel difference above 20; union of all native-frame foreground bounds, followed by a caller-selected static crop.
framing_authoring_aid.role: Authoring evidence for the chosen regions, not semantic certification or automatic subject tracking.
framing_authoring_aid.padding_limit: Native image boundaries constrain padding; Nami retains 39 pixels at the right rather than 48.

audio_review: No listening assessment; silent output is recorded as a technical stream property.
limitations: The composition review inspected the supplied samples and targeted full-resolution frames; it did not continuously watch or semantically inspect every output frame.
Fine finger detail, every-frame anatomy, foot sliding, flicker and all intervening transitions are not certified.
Clear studio borders and contained foreground bounds are conservative pixel proxies and cannot establish semantic quality.
Conversion from 24 fps to 30 fps duplicates frames and does not add motion information.
This acceptance applies to the exact digests below and establishes no success rate or reliability on unseen inputs.
packaging_note: Artifact names were remapped to retained sequence and original snapshot files; the reviewed digests and verdict are unchanged. The original review bytes are preserved separately.
